articles.title: A Dealmaking Frenzy Is Reshaping the Booming Wealth-Management Business
articles.mainIdea: A Dealmaking Frenzy Is Reshaping the Booming Wealth-Management Business
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: A Dealmaking Frenzy Is Reshaping the Booming Wealth-Management Business. Mark Armbruster used to know most of the other owners of wealth-management firms in the Rochester, N.Y., area. At 53 years old, Armbruster isn’t feeling pressure to take advantage of the paydays his rivals are landing. “It’s pretty constant,” Armbruster said.
